text: This is Star Raid. A sponsor puts up a wall of their token, and verified Lil Stars holders buy it out together, live, on Kuru's on-chain order book on Monad.

Community buys have three problems. Bots farm the rewards. Snipers wait for the last second. And the sponsor never knows if a real community showed up. Star Raid turns that into a short co-op game, with rules the chain enforces.
Here's the app. The lobby shows the next raid, a live countdown, and every raid so far, with walls broken and raids posted.

A sponsor opens the console and picks the terms: how much token goes on the wall, the price cap, a USDC prize, and a target. When the raid opens, the vault places the wall on Kuru at the cap, and it can't be pulled until the raid ends. Miss the target, and the prize rolls into the sponsor's next raid.

Raiders need one thing: a Lil Star. One Star is one seat per raid. That's the whole bot defence. A wallet without a seat can still buy, but it counts for nothing. Setup happens once: sign a seat pass, fund a small raid key with your budget, and every raid after that is one tap, with no wallet popups.

The window opens and the party hits the wall. Every hit is a real buy on Kuru, capped at the wall price. Cheaper asks fill first, and any leftover is cancelled and refunded in the same transaction. We count what each seat actually bought, from its balance change, and each seat has a cap, so one whale can't carry the raid. Now we're in the danger zone. The raid can end on any block from here.

When the window closes, nobody knows where it really ended, not even us. Pyth Entropy draws the end block from the danger zone. Then every hit is checked. Before the end block, it counts. After it, you keep your tokens, but earn no prize. So there's no point sniping the last second.

This is a real raid on Monad testnet. Fifty-eight hits from one seat counted five hundred and eighty against a five hundred target, so the wall broke. The prize splits across the seats by what each one counted. After a short hold, you open your chest, and share your card.
Price-capped buys on Kuru. A fair end from Pyth. A prize only for real Stars. That's Star Raid. Grab a seat for the next raid.
